locked_at: before any six-dataset evaluation of this method
selected_on: ETTh2 + ETTm2 historical audit windows only

method.prior_selection: EVIDENCE-SCALED BLEND over DENSE pseudo-origins: origins rolled one period at a time back from L-H while at least 8 periods of context remain; per-prior loss L_p averaged over them; w_p proportional to (L_min/L_p)^n_origins, renormalised. Parameter-free.
method.render: period matrix, rows=phase cols=period, 224x224, repeated over 16 frames
method.tokens: per-period-COLUMN token means (never global mean pooling)
method.kernel: fixed cosine similarity, query = last m=2 periods, keys = all earlier m-period windows whose successors are observed
method.combination: y = prior + rho * clip(kernel - prior, +-3*mean|diff|*sqrt(H)); rho = parameter-free top-k agreement

zero_shot_contract: no future value, no training, no benchmark-derived choice; all statistics from the observed context of each origin

dev_selection.split: HISTORICAL audit windows of all six datasets; the benchmark test windows were never touched
dev_selection.compared: 2 prior families x {argmin, uniform, invloss, softmin, softmin_n, pow_n} x {sparse, dense4, dense8} = 25 combiners
